text:
olivia: Hey team — rolling out GA for Local Audit Bundles for Private deployments today :tada: This lets on‑prem/VPC customers generate signed, tamper-evident audit bundles that never leave their network unless they explicitly export them. Docs + rollout schedule below.

ashish: huge — does this cover request/response payload scrubbing too?

olivia: good q. yes — bundles can be configured to include metadata-only, metadata+hashed-payloads, or full logs. default is metadata-only. scrub rules are pluggable per-tenant.

megan: key customer note: exported bundles are signed by a customer-provided key or our attestation key (opt-in). For compliance reviews customers can 1) hand us the signed bundle, or 2) we can do a live audit under customer supervision.

dario: deploying now to Private clusters in staged waves. rollout plan: wave 1 (pilot customers) today, wave 2 (early access customers) in 48h, GA for all Private clusters in 7 days.

security-bot: [AUTO] Vulnerability scan completed for build 4.12.1 — no critical findings.

olivia: config example for customers who want to opt in and keep logs local (put in private-config.yaml):
```yaml
local_audit_bundle:
  enabled: true
  mode: metadata_only  # options: metadata_only | hashed_payload | full 
  signing: customer_key  # options: customer_key | redwood_attestation | none
  retention_days: 365
  export_policy: manual  # manual | scheduled | disabled
```

ashish: will this increase disk needs for on-prem? any guidance on sizing?

megan: yes, bundles are compressed tar.gz files. estimate ~0.5-2% extra storage depending on traffic and mode. we'll add a sizing calculator to the docs page.

olivia: docs: https://redwood.internal/docs/private/local-audit-bundles (internal-only link) — includes examples, S3 transfer helper, and step-by-step export checklist for audits.

kate-support: Support FYI — if customers request migration help, please file a support task with label "lab:local-audit" and include their cluster id and desired mode. We have a zero-cost 2-hour onboarding session for pilots.

dario: known caveats: 1) export of full logs may contain user tokens if customers have custom telemetry enabled — recommend metadata_only for initial onboarding, 2) very large exports should use chunked transfer or physical media.

olivia: compliance note: this feature was validated by legal and our compliance partners for EU/UK audit workflows; we added additional attestations for Schengen-only customers.

megan: migration path for customers currently using central telemetry: we provide an export -> transform -> import helper that strips PII and re-signs bundles with customer key.

deploy-bot: [RELEASE] local-audit-bundles v1.0 deployed to staging clusters at 3260012350.

olivia: if any teams want a demo for specific customers, ping me or @ashish. we'll run two 30-min sessions tomorrow 10:00 and 15:00 PT.

ashish: will follow up with customer-facing one-pager + compliance FAQ.

olivia: thanks everyone — monitoring metrics: bundle-generation-time, bundle-size, and export-failures. I'll post daily for first 72h. :eyes:
